newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia mum on Ericsson price pressure view.
newsitem.headline: Nokia mum on Ericsson price pressure view.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy on Tuesday declined to comment on a statement by its Swedish rival Ericsson that price pressures would be similar in 1997 as in 1996, a Nokia spokesman told Reuters.

"We have a policy to not comment on our rivals' reports and especially now with our own report due the day after tomorrow, we want no part in the discussion," Nokia's head of corporate communications Seppo Harkonen said by telephone.
Nokia's 1996 report is due on Thursday at around 1300/1100 GMT.

Nokia's share wobbled earlier after an Ericsson official said he would not be surprised if price pressures this year would be the same as last, but by 1550/1350 GMT, the share returned to positive ground, trading 2.00 markka higher at 326.50 markka.
